name: operationscenter
author: Taako
description: An optional operations control plane with unified cog status, guided setup, bounded integration audits, failure notifications, and durable retries for supported TaakosCogs integrations.
install_msg: Run `[p]operationscenter setup #staff-operations` for guided optional integration setup.
short: Unified operations status, integration audits, setup, and retries.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild configuration, default and per-source alert channel IDs, muted source names, bounded integration event metadata, retry payload identifiers, attempt counts, errors, and timestamps. It does not store message content or secret values.
